formdata.value: Learned advanced implant placement techniques including guided surgery and immediate loading protocols. The course covered both theoretical and practical aspects of modern implantology.

This workshop has significantly improved my confidence in placing implants in complex cases. The hands-on sessions were particularly valuable and allowed me to practice new techniques under expert supervision.

I will implement guided surgery protocols in my next 5 implant cases, starting with single tooth replacements. I plan to use digital planning software more routinely and have already scheduled my first guided surgery case for next month.
